name: When is the best time to select interior finishing materials during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to select interior finishing materials during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to select interior finishing materials is during the early planning and design phases of your renovation project. Finalizing choices for items like flooring, tile, paint colors, cabinetry, and fixtures before construction begins is crucial. This allows your contractor to accurately plan the schedule, order materials with appropriate lead times, and prevent costly delays or design changes mid-project. Early selections ensure all elements complement each other and align with the overall design vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select interior finishing materials during the early planning and design stages to ensure proper scheduling, order materials, and avoid delays.
